_comment: Copy this file to metadata-instances.json and replace the values as described. The real-value file is excluded by .gitignore and must not be committed. api_key is the bearer token of the tdai kernel gateway, obtained from the kernel side. proxy_endpoint is optional and only affects the UI 'client access address' display; when running open-source core+proxy separately locally, set it to the proxy's external address (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8096), and omit it when the production/internal gateway sits behind the proxy.

instances.name: Dedicated to E2E automated tests (may be wiped at any time)
